 HTML5 | CSS3 | JavaScript (ES6) | TensorFlow.js | COCO-SSD | getUserMedia API

DigiVoter aims to transform the voting experience by leveraging AI-based facial recognition technology, eliminating the need for traditional paper-based methods. During the development of DigiVoter, we gained invaluable on-field work experience and gained a deep understanding of the electoral process, particularly through our involvement in the voter onboarding process for the DigiVoter.
